card.name: Linking words before gases or smoke
card.fires_on: Small linking words (until, to, in, or, without) right before an expected gas or air-related word such as smoke, oxygen, or N2O. Seen in recipe heating steps and in inhaled anesthetic descriptions.

modes.label: Anesthetic gas mixtures
modes.description: Linking words like in, or, without after an anesthetic agent, ahead of oxygen or nitrous oxide.
modes.example: Induction with isoflurane in oxygen or<< in>> combination with oxygen-nitrous oxide

modes.label: Cooking until smoking
modes.description: The word until or to in oil-heating steps, ahead of smoke.
modes.example: Heat 1 tablespoon vegetable oil in Dutch oven over high heat<< until>> just starting to smoke

card.writes: It pushes up air, gas, and atmosphere words and pushes down water words.
card.plain: It fires on small words that come just before a gas such as oxygen, nitrous oxide, or smoke is named.
